interpretation: KmpFile.getSize invokes isDirectory for content URIs; DocumentFile SingleDocumentFile delegates to DocumentsContractApi19, which queries mime_type.
The actual cached FileProvider query supports _display_name and _size only, trimming unknown projection columns; a mime_type-only query produces a zero-column MatrixCursor row.

DocumentsContractApi19.queryForString catches Exception and returns its default null. MIME-directory probing via this FileProvider has a protocol mismatch and observed zero-column warnings in passing cases.
Provider restart/death and the known-size null assertion are distinct runtime evidence; these disassemblies do not demonstrate causal provider termination or authorize a source change.
limitations: The inspected AARs are the locally cached declared coordinates; this static review alone is not an APK dependency-resolution certification.
Neither bytecode nor temporal co-occurrence identifies who killed provider4726, why a later size query returned null, or how long a future device run would require.
No production/test repair, runtime retry, weakened assertion or gate promotion is proposed as already verified.
